Field Error/Damage.question: Reference: SLP1 - RFI 2087 - PSD Stair 2 Concrete Landing Cracking Remediation Confirmation Sheet A7.02, E0.02, E2.03 Submittal 3472 - PSD Light Fixture (Product Data) Attached Pictures Background: At the Stair 2 concrete landings of Tiers 3-5, it is being noticed that water is seeping through the cracks and into the installed light fixture below. Per conversations with the SEOR, these cracks appear to be due to shrinkage and temperature and do not raise structural concerns. The installed light fixtures are "wet location rated". "Wet Location Rated" is defined as an electrical enclosure that is "dust tight and watertight against light pressure water spray". With the intense rains and recent power washing activities, the cracks are allowing more water than what the light fixtures are rated for. To fix this issue, DPR has (2) proposed solutions: Option A: Open crack 1/4" to create amplitude and fill with urethane sealant caulking. ROM of $1,000 to complete this scope at all locations. Option B: Traffic Coat concrete landings to seal the cracking. ROM of $50,000 to complete this scope at all locations. Question: Please confirm which option DES/PMA would like to proceed with.
Field Error/Damage.resolution: Julia Morini (DES Architects & Engineers, Inc. - 10012655): Please see attached.
